dex.entry: A mid-stage strike-bird whose beak has hardened into a flint-edged chisel that sparks on every strike, and whose charge builds faster the more consecutive hits it lands. The beak-as-thunderstrike concept makes every hit feel satisfying — a natural woodpecker of electricity.

art.silhouette: Lean raptor, dark charcoal and slate-blue feathers, a dramatically elongated flint-edged beak that cracks sparks on impact, talons wrapped in static; focused aggression at 48px.
